labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE: patched FS-UAE 3.2.35 (build-fsuae-native.sh — mousehack re-arm) runs on the host inside a pinned Xvfb :58 sized to the emulator window; the daemon captures the X root (SH_CAPTURE=x11) and injects input over XTEST (SH_X11TEST_ABS/_BUTTONS/_KEYS). Launcher stations/amigaos35/x11-runtime.sh.

museum.blurb: The classic Amiga's 1999 swan song: five years after Commodore died, a fan-driven Amiga Inc shipped one last 68k AmigaOS with GlowIcons, CD-ROM support and a bundled web suite — booting a real 68040 big-box with the AWeb II browser two clicks away.
museum.notes: Live streamhost tile, HOST-NATIVE from birth (never a bridge): patched FS-UAE 3.2.35 on the host under a pinned Xvfb, x11 root capture + XTEST input (the backend completed for this station). AGA chipset screen (640x512 laced, 64 colours) rather than RTG because UAE statefiles and RTG conflict — instant golden restore won. Kickstart 3.1 r40.068 + OS 3.5 CD media staged in /data/assets-staging/amigaos35 (preservation-class, never committed). Distinct from the amiga (A500/WB1.3 bridge) and aros (x86 reimplementation) tiles; archetype beige-tower-crt (ideal: an A4000 big-box tower). See docs/guests/amigaos35.md.

network.note: Retronet web plane via a NETNS CAGE: FS-UAE has no tap/pcap backend, so its bsdsocket_library host sockets are opened inside netns rn-amigaos35, whose only interface is the guest end of veth amiga35-h/amiga35-g; the host end is enslaved to vmbr-rn (no uplink). Static 10.99.0.26 (reservation kept in RETRONET_DHCP_RESERVATIONS), MAC per the fleet scheme in gitignored local.env (RN_AMIGAOS35_MAC), no default route in the netns, fail-closed AMIGAOS35RN-IN chain above RETRONET-IN. Containment proven from inside the cage: gateway 10.99.0.2 serves DNS+HTTP, 10.99.0.1 drops 100%, 1.1.1.1 unroutable at the stack. rn-netns.sh up runs from the launcher on every start and re-verifies its own rules. See docs/lab/retronet/WEB-STATION-amigaos35.md.

reset.fixture: AmigaOS 3.5 Workbench desktop, 640x512 laced 64-colour AGA screen in a 720x568 window: Ram Disk + System + AWeb-II icons, no windows open; AWeb's saved home page is http://www.amiga.de/ (retronet corpus). resetMode=relaunch with FSUAE_NATIVE_CHECKPOINT=0: reset is a DETERMINISTIC COLD BOOT (~85 s to the desktop) of a fresh work HDF reflinked from disk/amigaos35-system.hdf.golden. UAE savestates were tried and rejected for this station: a state restored with bsdsocket_library enabled gurus nondeterministically and its pre-crash flush can corrupt the work disk, and a restored mousehack consumes packets one event late (the fsuae-mousehack-rearm.patch stays in the pinned build for any future revisit). The standby freeze keeps visits instant; only a reset pays the boot. BAKE RULE: the golden HDF is captured from a SIGSTOPped idle session and its FFS root bm_flag must then be set valid (0xffffffff, checksum refreshed) — FFS sets the flag only on flush/unmount, and OS 3.5's validator fails loudly ('Block 1146049281 (DOS\\1) out of range') on a dirty xdftool-built volume instead of healing. Mouse/keyboard PASS on the production rig 2026-08-25 (cold boot; XTEST paced, RAmiga=Super_R).
